notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Scene Forensics reads the real footage's lighting, camera motion, and spatial layout → Insert Director specifies a character/object to add, its entry point, and its behavior, matched to the scene's real lighting direction and perspective → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video generates the insert with the source footage as structural/lighting reference, preserving the real background exactly → Integration Critic (does the inserted element cast correct shadows, match perspective, and hold up under a 'play it again' rewatch?) → Repair on any integration seam → Package.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION A few real seconds of the user's own footage plus the character or object reference to insert.
STAGE 2 — INSERT DIRECTOR Specifies what enters, where it enters, how it behaves, and how it matches the real scene's light direction and perspective.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 VIDEO-TO-VIDEO INSERT The source footage is the structural and lighting reference; the real background is preserved exactly.
STAGE 4 — INTEGRATION CRITIC + SEAM REPAIR Correct shadows, matched perspective, and does it hold up on a second watch?
